title: AN OUT-REACH PROGRAM AT GOVT. HIGH SCHOOL, HAROHALLY ORGANIZED BY ATMECE ON “IMPORTANCE OF GRAMMAR IN LANGUAGES, MATHS AND BASIC RIGHTS OF THE CITIZENS’
content:
AN OUT-REACH PROGRAM AT GOVT. HIGH SCHOOL, HAROHALLY ORGANIZED BY ATMECE

on

“IMPORTANCE OF GRAMMAR IN LANGUAGES, MATHS AND BASIC RIGHTS OF THE CITIZENS’

Department of Humanities, Mathematics in association with Women Cell ATME College of engineering, Mysuru had organized An outreach program for the students of Government High School, Harohalli Village, Varuna Hobli, Mysuru Taluk on “Importance of Grammar in Languages, basic mathematics concepts and knowledge of basic Fundamental Rights” on 10th January 2026.

The outreach program was organized with the objective of creating awareness among school students about: The importance of grammar in different languages for effective communication. Basic mathematics concepts for strengthening foundational knowledge. Fundamental Rights, Human Rights, and Fundamental Duties of citizens as enshrined in the Constitution of India.
